event_summary: Official IPL 2026 Retentions Announced: RR retains 16 players spending Rs 108.95 Cr with Rs 16.05 Cr purse remaining.
Trade window closes: Ravindra Jadeja traded to RR (revised Rs 14 Cr fee); Sanju Samson traded to CSK (Rs 18 Cr fee).
RR signs 9 auction players (Bishnoi, Milne, Sen, Mishra, Punja, Brijesh Sharma, Puthur, Ravi Singh, Perala) spending Rs 13.80 Cr.
RR finishes 4th in league stage (8 wins, 6 losses), wins Eliminator vs RCB, falls in Qualifier 2 to Gujarat Titans.
CCI approves controlling acquisition of Rajasthan Royals parent by Westview Cricket (Mittal family ~75%) and Poonawalla Sports (~18%).
Blockbuster trades confirmed: Hardik Pandya <-> Arshdeep Singh; Rishabh Pant <-> Kuldeep Yadav; Natarajan to SRH.
Four-player trade: Liam Livingstone & Jack Edwards to CSK; Khaleel Ahmed & Nathan Ellis to SRH.
IPL Governing Council confirms retention deadline of November 17, 2026 and Mini-Auction on December 16, 2026 in Goa.
Reports surface of talks around Shami and Curran; Jaiswal-to-LSG trade speculation confirmed stalled/closed.
RR-EDGE V4.1 Freeze at 16:37 IST ahead of the November 17 pre-retention deadline.
